headline: Choose with confidence.
prompt: Create a finished premium portrait 4:5 advertising POSTER for ONPOINT CIVILS. CREATIVE DIRECTION: warm relatable CONTEMPORARY MODERN AFRICAN lifestyle advertising. Attractive well-maintained contemporary Zimbabwean settings and current professional equipment. Do NOT signal Africa through dilapidation, old broken buildings, poverty, dusty neglected streets, colonial nostalgia or safari clichés. Modern Zimbabwean commercial buildings, contemporary homes, new infrastructure, clean current machinery and well-organised construction sites. Black African engineers and clients in contemporary attire; correct hard hats, high visibility vests and boots on active sites. Prosperous professional present-day Africa. Site work is orderly, safe and realistic. Topic: "Before choosing a contractor.". Invent a visually specific authentic scene about THIS topic, informed by: Ask about relevant project experience; Discuss capacity and quality procedures; Clarify scope, programme and communication. Candid medium-wide human interaction with contemporary environment as part of the story, airy editorial headline space. Natural skin, anatomically correct hands, unforced expression, premium southern African lifestyle photography, gorgeous warm daylight. Photo occupies at least 70% of poster. Sophisticated navy, warm cream, golden yellow accents and cream negative space, strong readable editorial typography. Brand at top as small PLAIN TYPESET text "ONPOINT CIVILS", no invented logo. Main headline EXACTLY "Choose with confidence.". Short service line "Roads • Buildings • Water & sewer". Footer CTA "Let’s discuss your requirements." then "+263 782 381 986" and "onpointcivils.co.zw". Very small "Illustrative image". No other text, checklists, day/month numbers, badges, fake reviews, ratings, certifications, invented offers or guarantees. Models and scenes are fictional illustrative advertising, not documentary customer work. Distinctive visually memorable commercial design, not a repeated text card or stiff corporate stock image.
